summary.headline: Lots, Exaltations, and Fortunate Nativities
summary.text: Astrological discussion of the lots of Fortune and the daimon, their relation to bodily, intellectual, and worldly affairs, and their placement in pivots, succedents, and declines. It treats the Sun’s and Moon’s exaltations, glorious nativities, acquisition, debt, theft, ambush, dignity, and example planetary configurations involving Leo, Libra, Aquarius, and Gemini.
